content: Amǝ Isǝrayila alta kum murǝm
Lang yi bwalna arǝ apǝlǝkia mala e mala Samuyila ka, tsǝk amuni ɓǝà duk amǝ'ɓashi amur amǝ Isǝrayila.
Lullǝ muna-dǝmba male nda Joyel, sǝ ɓaria muni ka, lullǝi nda Abija. À duk amǝ'ɓashi a Biyasheba.
Amuni ka, à twal kusǝi ɗàng, à kyanggî njar ace alta kume, à ak pàbunǝnzali sǝ à pūrǝ ɓashi.
Pǝlǝa aɓwana-mǝgule mala Isǝrayila kat, ram rǝia abanɓwáná sǝ à yiu aban Samuyila a Rama;
à yi ne wi ama, <<Sǝni, a ena, sǝ amunio twalkusǝo ɗàng. Ado ka, tsǝka sǝm murǝm mǝnana nǝ̀ yálmúr sǝm kǝla mala acili anzali kat ka.>>
Sǝama cau mǝnia à ne ama, <<Pà sǝm murǝm mǝnana nǝ̀ yálmúr sǝm>> ngga, pwasǝbum Samuyila ɗàng. Nda Samuyila pakhiwi aban Yahweh ka.
Osso Yahweh banggi Samuyila ama, <<Kpata gì aɓwana man, pàk gìr mǝnana kat à banggo ka, acemǝnana a nda mǝnana à ginǝo ka ɗàng, mǝ nda mǝnana à ginǝam ɓǝn nggá duk murǝm amúrià raka.
Kǝla mǝnana à pa, twal a pwari mǝnana ǝn pusǝia à purî ɓá Masar ba yalung ngga, à ginǝkiam, sǝ à peri aban aɓea aɓakuli ka, nda kǝgìr mǝnana à kǝ pakko gbal ka.
Acemani ka, kpata gia; sǝama awu nǝ nunkiria pepè, sǝ awu nǝ bǝlia wia lang sǝ murǝm mǝnana nǝ̀ yálmuria ka nǝ̀ pàngŋǝ́nǝia.>>
Nunkiru mala Samuyila arǝ amurǝma
Anggo sǝ Samuyila bang acau mala Yahweh kat aban aɓwana mǝnana à alkiyita murǝm a baní ka.
Bang ama, <<Ani sǝ murǝm mǝnana nǝ̀ yálmúr wun ngga, nǝ̀ pangnǝ wun: nǝ̀ twal amuna ma'wun nǝ̀ tsǝia à nǝ̀ duk amǝkok awaru-pǝr andǝ apǝr male mǝnana à nǝ̀ nggǝ ɓang aɓadǝm awaru-pǝr male ka.

Sǝ nǝ̀ tsǝkî ɓamurì amǝ'sàrǝ̀ban amur aɓwana á-á, andǝ amǝ'sàrǝ̀ban amur aɓwana á-lumi-tongno, sǝ aɓea ka à nǝ̀ duk amǝ'rya andǝ amǝ'pwan-gìrɓaban male, andǝ amǝ'tulki agirbura mala lwa andǝ agirtúró mala awaru-pǝr male.
Nǝ̀ twal amuna-mamǝna ma'wun ɓǝà pǝlǝ amǝ'pakki agir pà'rǝmban-mǝɓoarne, andǝ amǝ'lamggi agirlina, andǝ amǝ'lúrǝ́gir.
Nǝ̀ ak aɓaban mǝɓoarne ma'wun andǝ aɓaban-anap, andǝ aɓaban mala anggun-olif ma'wun sǝ nǝ̀ pè amǝ'túró male.
Nǝ ak kāmbe mwashat aɓa lum mala mǝsǝsa andǝ aɓǝla-anap ma'wun, sǝ nǝ̀ pè amǝgulo andǝ amǝ'túró male.
Nǝ̀ twal aguro ma'wun aburana andǝ amamǝna, andǝ alaggana mǝnana à nda dwat ka, andǝ amǝdambǝriso ma'wun, sǝ nǝ̀ tsǝia aɓa túró male.
Nǝ̀ ak kāmbe mwashat aɓa lum mala agirkusǝu ma'wun, sǝ wun nǝ̀ duk aguro male.
A pwarì mǝno ka, wun nǝ̀ ɓua ace kum usǝlǝo a bù murǝm mǝnana wu tàrrî ɓamurǝ wun ngga, sǝ Yahweh pà nǝ̀ oka wun amǝno yì pwari ka ɗàng.>>
Yahweh pè amǝ Isǝrayila zǝmba malea
Kat andǝ manì ka, aɓwe ginǝ okî Samuyila. À bang ama, <<Awo, ma'sǝm ngga sǝm nggǝ earce murǝm amur sǝm,
ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ sǝm pa kǝla acili anzali kat, sǝ ɗǝm ngga ɓǝ̀ murǝm ma'sǝm ɓǝ̀ kǝ pakka sǝm ɓashi sǝ ɓǝ̀ dupa sǝm a dǝmba, sǝ nǝ̀ lwa-lwa ma'sǝm.>>
Lang Samuyila ongŋǝna acau mala aɓwe ka, ɓǝsǝlǝia ɓǝ̀ Yahweh oea.
Sǝ Yahweh banggi Samuyila ama, <<Kpata gia sǝ wu pea wia murǝm.>> Samuyila pǝlǝa ne aburana mala Isǝrayila ama, <<Koyan ngga ɓǝ̀ nyare a nggea-là male.>>
